recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Suspect in Belleville synagogue shooting dies in hospital: SIU
recentItems.description:
Sean Ward, 29, accused of opening fire on police Const. Jeff Smith outside a Belleville, Ont. synagogue during Yom Kippur services on Sunday night, has died in hospital, according to Ontario’s Special Investigations Unit. Smith, who was stationed outside the synagogue and has served with Belleville police since 2013, suffered serious injuries in the shootout and remains in critical but stable condition.
